name: disco
//: Four of the eight people on the dance floor; the other four are in dance. Split so that they are drawn large: the size a row gets is decided by its width, and eight at 54 dots come to 273 cells across against the 167 an ordinary terminal has, so the row fell to 36 and every dancer with it. Four hold 98 cells at 54. Each is told apart by one bold mark and by the dance, and by nothing else.
//heights: Traced from a drawing, so the pen is measured off it and taken to three dots.
